2609.31563.title: Multi-agent Scaling Across Disjunctive and Compensatory Tasks
2609.31563.paper_summary: Multi-agent LLM systems are often expected to improve as team size increases, yet the scaling behavior may depend on task structure. Our central contribution is to introduce Steiner's taxonomy of group tasks as a framework for analyzing multi-agent LLM scaling and focusing the analysis on disjunctive and compensatory tasks. We model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item, which yields their large-team limits: plurality voting converges to the model's modal answer, and averaging converges to the model's item-level bias. Across selected representative benchmarks, 13 open-weight models, and teams of up to 30 agents, we find qualitatively different scaling behavior. On disjunctive tasks, the probability that at least one agent is correct grows by 5-20 points with team size, but plurality voting over agents that answer directly realises almost none of this potential, as the model predicts to within 0.5 points on average. Multi-round revision raises accuracy considerably, yet the gain is nearly the same with one peer as with 29. In contrast, scaling provides little benefit on Fermi estimation, despite its natural suitability for aggregation: item-level biases shared across the samples of a model account for about 87% of the squared error, so averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Combining model families helps on Fermi estimation but does not surpass the strongest member on disjunctive tasks. These results show that task structure, together with the mechanism combining member outputs, is a fundamental determinant of team scaling.
2609.31563.paper_summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統通常預期隨著團隊規模的增加而改善，然而擴展行為可能取決於任務結構。我們的主要貢獻是引入施泰納的群體任務分類法作為分析多代理 LLM 擴展的框架，並將分析重點放在析取任務和補償任務上。我們將獨立抽樣的代理建模為在給定項目下條件獨立，這產生了它們的大型團隊極限：多數投票收斂到模型的眾數答案，而平均值收斂到模型的項目級偏差。在選定的代表性基準、13 個開放權重模型和最多 30 個代理的團隊中，我們發現擴展行為質量上有所不同。在析取任務中，至少有一個代理正確的概率隨著團隊規模增長 5-20 個百分點，但對於直接回答的代理進行的多數投票幾乎沒有實現這一潛力，因為模型的預測平均在 0.5 個百分點內。多輪修訂顯著提高了準確性，但與一個同伴相比，增益幾乎相同，無論是與 29 個同伴。相較之下，儘管費米估計自然適合聚合，但擴展對其的好處不大：模型樣本之間共享的項目級偏差約占平方誤差的 87%，因此平均值僅減少約 6% 的誤差。結合模型家族對費米估計有幫助，但在析取任務上不超過最強的成員。這些結果表明，任務結構以及結合成員輸出的機制是團隊擴展的基本決定因素。
2609.31563.author: Carolina Fortuna et.al.
